description.short: Azure Migrate inventories and assessments from Cowork.
description.full: Copilot Cowork plugin for Azure Migrate (__ENV_DESCRIPTION__). Creates or updates a server inventory for the signed-in user on the Azure Migrate Discovery Service and returns an azcopy command the user runs on their own machine to upload the file, updates an existing inventory from a message alone (corrections, guidance, questions), reports the inventory status and exports the refined inventory or offline zip. Creates an assessment, starts the HA assessment and reports their status. POC.

agentConnectors.description: Azure Migrate tools: create or update a server inventory from a file on the user's machine or update it from a message, check its status and export it; create an assessment and HA assessment and check their status.
